2034-2557-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2557-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

803-2638-3000-3510.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2638-3000-3510.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1722-2034-3583-6634.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6634.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-3249-4474--206.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
728-1303-3249-4474--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3755-4687-4893.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
3755-4687-4893.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

2921-3184-4766--190.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio trigger.
Repeat.

967-2921-3809-7087-7824.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1580-2511-4871-6887.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3197-7173-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-7173-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-3899-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating three creature tokens
Activate two tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing two tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

757-1719-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

1339-4279-7173.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-7173.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2921-3678-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6159-6662.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6159-6662.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

478-6871-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping The Eternity Elevator and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.
478-6871-6893.notes: You can tap The Eternity Elevator for colored mana instead if it has enough charge counters on it.

1168-1651-1863-5542-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1863-5542-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-1863-5542-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Delney, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-5078-6650--30.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1170-5078-6650--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

2908-3152-6623.description:
Activate Somberwald Sage by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Somberwald Sage.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1315-2173-2573-4423-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
1315-2173-2573-4423-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-2173-2573-4423-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
1315-2173-2573-4423-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

5670-6094-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6094-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

5226-5362-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
5226-5362-5365.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
5226-5362-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

647-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
647-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

5686-5853-5929.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
5686-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Snail, creating a Blood token.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1309-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Salvager of Secrets each turn.
1309-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Salvager of Secrets by paying its mana cost.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Salvager of Secrets from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3967-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
3967-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2082-3197-5256.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2082-3197-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2082-3197-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

56-2292-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

3536-4316-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

190-389-1276.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, cast Fracturing Gust by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

245-1308-2034.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Anointed Procession.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1283-1409-2608.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
1283-1409-2608.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Derevi by paying {2}, blinking itself.
Derevi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Derevi.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability to draw infinite cards.
